settings.name: W & C Glazing
settings.about: W & C Glazing is a family business in Ballygowan founded by Billy and Celia Magill. Originally serving domestic glazing, the business expanded into commercial glazing and curtain walling. Its work covers design, fabrication and installation for new builds, renovations and extensions.

services.title: Aluminium Curtain Walling
services.short: Glazing for commercial and architectural projects.
services.body: W & C Glazing works with clients and architects on the design, fabrication and installation of aluminium curtain walling. Its published portfolio includes refurbishment and mixed-use development projects.

services.title: Aluminium Windows & Doors
services.body: The company supplies and installs aluminium windows and doors for domestic and commercial buildings. Discuss the design, finish and application with the team.

services.title: PVC Windows & Doors
services.short: Practical glazing for homes and renovation projects.
services.body: W & C Glazing designs, fabricates and installs PVC windows and doors. Published projects include sliding sash windows and PVC glazing for new homes.

services.title: Composite Doors
services.short: A considered entrance for your home.
services.body: Composite doors are part of the published W & C Glazing portfolio. The Crawfordsburn and Saintfield case studies include composite doors, and the original site links to the Apeer doorbuilder. Discuss styles and availability directly with the team.

services.title: Bi-Fold Aluminium Doors
services.short: Connect living space with the outdoors.
services.body: The published portfolio includes aluminium bi-fold doors. The Crawfordsburn case study describes bi-fold doors in the kitchen opening towards the garden. Discuss the opening dimensions and project requirements.

services.title: Patio Doors
services.short: Open up your home to light and access.
services.body: Patio doors feature in the company’s published galleries and projects, including Comber Mill Village. Discuss your opening, material and finish requirements with the team.

services.title: Roof Lights
services.short: Bring daylight into your living space.
services.body: Roof lights are included in the published works gallery. Contact the team to discuss the type of opening, glazing and installation needed for your project.

services.title: Glass & Maintenance
services.short: Glazing support for homes and businesses.
services.body: Alongside new builds, renovations and extensions, W & C Glazing lists glass supply for general maintenance around homes and offices. Contact the team with the dimensions and details of the work required.
